description: Materials recorded on a job (or one visit), with the price and cost totals of those still counted. Prices show only with see_prices, costs only with see_costs; lines with no price or cost set are counted in unpriced_count and uncosted_count.
name: materials_list

cost_total_minor.description: Amount in minor units of the currency (cents), or null.

cost_minor.description: quantity x unit cost, rounded half up.

price_minor.description: quantity x unit price, rounded half up.

unit_cost_minor.description: Cost per unit as recorded. null when none was set, or unless you may see costs (see_costs).

unit_price_minor.description: Price per unit as recorded. null when none was set, or unless you may see prices (see_prices).

price_total_minor.description: Amount in minor units of the currency (cents), or null.
